payload.consequence: Whether all 26 finding identities across R1 through R12 reconcile in both directions is undetermined, because the aggregate-conformance gate that would establish it is the step that did not run. Two defects of that exact class did occur in the adjacent retained evidence and were caught only because Standards reviewers audited it: R6-standards-1 found no R2-standards identity recorded anywhere plus an unkeyed entry that could not be compared in either direction, and R7-standards-3 found a stale count. The review substance did run every pass and both axes reported no actionable findings at R12; what is missing is the artifact that would prove the finding set was completely accounted for.
payload.expected: Step 5 aggregates: present both axis reports under Standards and Spec headings retaining each Reviewed HEAD line; add a Findings fixed during review ledger in the specified nine-column schema; run the aggregate-conformance gate comparing every emitted finding identity in both directions against the final residual reports plus the ledger; compare each Standards report's Standards sources checked line in both directions against the selected source list; and end with the prescribed one-line summary.
payload.observed: Steps 1 through 4 ran on every pass: endpoints pinned as SHAs, monotonic pass IDs R1 through R12, two isolated axis sub-agents launched in parallel each pass, stable finding IDs with both routing fields required and received, and HEAD re-verified after each pass. Step 5 was not performed on any pass: the axis reports were consumed internally and never presented under the two headings, no Findings fixed during review ledger was produced in the specified schema, the aggregate-conformance and coverage-line comparisons were never run as both-directions gates, and the prescribed one-line summary was never emitted.
payload.run_condition: Twelve two-axis passes over a 14-file change, 24 axis sub-agents and 26 findings; the reporting contract was unmet from the first pass and every pass after, so not a late-run drift; no gate caught it during the run, and it surfaced only on re-reading the skill text during this capture.
